fields.label: Allowed Scopes
fields.help: List of scopes that are allowed to be requested for this auth_provider.

fields.label: Auth Provider ID
fields.help: The ID to use for the AuthProvider, which will become the final segment of the AuthProvider's resource name.

fields.label: Blocked Scopes
fields.help: List of scopes that are blocked from being requested for this auth_provider.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'.

fields.label: Authorization URL
fields.help: The authorization endpoint to send users to for consenting to delegate to the agent.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.help: The client ID of the OAuth client.

fields.label: Default Continue Uri
fields.help: The default continue URI for 3LO flow and it will be used when no continue URI is provided in the RetrieveCredentials request.

fields.label: Enable Pkce
fields.help: Enables Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) for the OAuth flow to prevent authorization code interception attacks.

fields.label: Token URL
fields.help: The token endpoint for requesting tokens on behalf of an end user.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.help: The client ID of the OAuth client.

fields.label: Token URL
fields.help: The token endpoint of the OAuth client.
